labelsNOT RUN. label_guard is built for a deck that prints a place, an act and a claim id together, and fails closed when compute.py carries no shape map. This deck prints source attributions instead. It is not in CI and shipped_check is clean.

sitepass: schema_check, site_fresh_check, seo_check, link_check, media_check, numeral_lint
ownershippass, 280 paths all inside 'daily'

What degraded

  • The scanner's daily ceiling was NOT checked. This session has no Supabase connector, so the query in the routine could not run at all. A requester who hit the cap today was told the day was full and nobody was told.
  • label_guard did not run. It is built for a deck that prints a place, an act and a claim id together, and it fails closed when compute.py carries no shape map. This deck prints source attributions rather than act labels, so the gate is answering a question it was not given. It is not in CI and shipped_check is clean.
  • The geography backlog held steady at three rather than shrinking. One of the three, tx-2026-0007, already carries statewide true, so the line describing it is false about the current record and can never clear while docket_build.backlog prints every id in its exemption dict unconditionally.
  • The caption's closing move is 'ask the one question the decision leaves open' for the fourth run running, because brand.yaml sets linkedin_post.ends_with to engagement_question and that collapses CAPTION_CRAFT's five closing moves into one.

Named here rather than left out. A run that quietly ships less than it planned teaches nobody anything.

Post this

Upload the PDF to LinkedIn as a document, title it The order stands and the question underneath it is open, Docket 59220, paste the post copy under it, then paste the first comment within a minute of posting.

carousel.pdf   contact sheet   the site

1. The post copy

Two numbers in this order look alike.

One is GOODNIT1, a stand-alone 265.5 MW wind generation resource in Armstrong County. The other is a 265 MW data center complex at its point of interconnection, beside a second complex of 260 MW.

On July 24th, 2026 the Public Utility Commission of Texas approved the net metering arrangement subject to conditions. The 260 MW load has to curtail fully within 30 minutes when ERCOT directs it.

Ownership of the second load has not transferred yet. On August 18th, 2026 Ensign Infrastructure moved for rehearing, arguing the duty should be sized to the existing generator the statute is about.

The deck reads the order, then the motion against it.

A separate commission review of the offer caps takes comments until September 17th, 2026.

What does a commission do with a motion asking it to lift its own conditions?

#ArmstrongCounty #ERCOT #Docket59220

Notes

Twelve proposals, each out of the `daily` lane and written down rather than made. The full text of every one, with the evidence and the verified diffs, is committed beside the run at runs/carousel/2026-08-28/proposals.md on main. 1. The caption ledger's exclusion lists are wrong in both directions, and a judge used them 2. `label_guard` fails closed on decks that print no act labels 3. `docket_build.backlog` prints an exemption that no longer describes anything 4. `brand.yaml`'s `ends_with: engagement_question` collapses five closing moves into one 5. The scout agents cannot write the file the routine tells them to write 6. `plan_render_check`'s palette regex cannot express this project's own token names 7. The site publishes the commission's sentences as this project's own prose 8. A gate can prove a URL is correct and still not prove it is readable 9. The artwork ledger compares palettes for equality, and the collisions are near misses 10. A document-structure locator is a claim, and nothing checks that one traces 11. An assertion about arithmetic is not an assertion about a source 12. `panel.py` cannot tell a threshold dissent from a named fault, so the cap can't fire The two this run paid for hardest: 10 is the locator gate. Six document-structure locators shipped on published surfaces and not one traced to a claim. Every one was TRUE, which is exactly why nothing caught them. The check was written and run as evidence: over the render's text nodes plus the caption and the first comment it reads 25 tokens with 0 untraced. The script ships beside the run. 11 is the sum that was not a source. This run added 260 MW load + 265.5 MW generation to slide 6 on a judge's advice, guarded by an assertion that the components equalled the quoted total. Every gate passed and the sentence was false: the order's recital adds the two LOADS, so the 265.5 is a load and the frame called it generation. An arithmetic identity between three quoted figures is a tautology and certifies nothing. Deleting the sentence then left the SLOPE saying the same thing in geometry. A slope is a sentence.

This is a draft. Nothing was sent. The deck is already merged to main, so these links are live. Posting is the only step left, and it is yours.
